content.introduction: The sources indicate that the 12-month percentage change in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) for selected categories has varied over time. For instance, the data from Marotta on Money shows a range of percentage changes from -4.0% to 6.0% over the past 20 years, with shaded areas representing recession periods. The US Inflation Calculator provides CPI values from 1913 to 2026, showing a 3.4% change in 2023 and a 2.9% change in 2024. The San Francisco Fed's data focuses on the contributions to 12-month headline CPI inflation from various categories, but does not provide specific 12-month percentage changes for selected categories. The sources do not provide a definitive answer for the exact 12-month percentage change in selected CPI categories for 2026.

Figures 1 and 2 focus on the 12-month, or year-over-year, change in prices. Figure 1 shows 12-month headline CPI and core CPI inflation. Figure 2 shows the contributions to 12-month headline CPI inflation from four categories: housing, core services excluding housing, core goods, and food and energy. Figures 3 and 4 mirror these two figures but focus on monthly inflation instead.
